label: Deepgram
agentGuide: Base path /v1. Transcribe an audio file by URL: POST /listen?model=nova-3&smart_format=true&language=fr {"url": "https://.../audio.mp3"} (results.channels[0].alternatives[0].transcript; add &diarize=true for speakers, &paragraphs=true, &summarize=v2, &detect_language=true). A local file cannot be sent through this relay (binary body): give a URL. Text to speech: POST /speak?model=aura-2-thalia-en {"text": "..."} (audio bytes, save_as). Text intelligence: POST /read?summarize=true&topics=true {"text": "..."}. Projects and usage: GET /projects, GET /projects/<id>/usage?start=YYYY-MM-DD&end=YYYY-MM-DD, balances: GET /projects/<id>/balances. The key is set by Allkin.
